text:
deploybot: PRE-FLIGHT CHECK FAILED: env parity check found SIGIL mismatch on SECRET_PATH between staging and prod. flagged key: "/services/inference/kv@cache_prefix" vs prod "/services/inference/kv$cache_prefix". blocking release.
augie: ack. wtf — how did @ get in there?
sarah: that looks like a templating artefact from an older helm chart. previously we used @ as placeholder during local renders.
mike: confirmable — saw a local dev override using `kv@cache_prefix` in a dotfile last week.
jenn: is it safe to backfill prod to use @? that seems risky.
dan: nope. changing prod format would break compatibility with parsing code that expects `$` sigil. we should instead normalize staging to prod format.
augie: agree. roll back release? or patch staging and re-run checks?
sarah: patch staging, re-run deploycheck. low-risk: sed replace in Helm values and re-render. example: ```yaml
# staging-values.yaml (snippet)
cache_prefix: "/services/inference/kv$cache_prefix"
# was: "/services/inference/kv@cache_prefix"
```
mike: I'll prepare the change and run the preflight locally + CI. leaving a canary window of 30m after we re-run.
deploybot: action required: release paused. add PR link when ready. note: change window ends today 23:00 UTC.
jenn: also double-check any secret rotation automation — some of those jobs read the path and might create keys under the wrong prefix.
dan: good call. @ops-bot can you list recent KMS writes matching both prefixes in the last 7 days?
ops-bot: query started: `aws kms list-aliases --filter name:/services/inference/kv` -> 3 aliases found, none with @ in alias name, but found 2 SSM params with @ in name under dev accounts.
augie: thanks. seems like it was purely local/dev contamination. still want to run a quick grep across infra repos for `kv@` to catch any other stray overrides.
sarah: running grep now, will paste results.
mike: if we re-run deploycheck and it's green, do we still want to pin the service image for this rollout? I'd pin for one hour to avoid accidental autosync.
jenn: +1 on pin for 1h. also add a release note blurb: "fixed env var sigil in staging values to match prod; release was paused".
augie: timeline: mike does PR, jenn reviews, merge -> re-run deploycheck -> if green, deploy to staging -> 30m canary -> unpause. anyone object?
dan: no objections. if deploycheck fails again, we rollback to previous image and open incident.
augie: thanks everyone. mike, please post the PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
mike: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1245 ready for review, includes grep cleanup and unit test for values linting.
deploybot: noted. release remains paused until `deploycheck` passes.
augie: updating release notes and change window entry. will also flag a tech debt ticket to add a linter rule preventing `@` sigil in env paths.
sarah: added test to CI that fails if regex `kv@` appears in committed helm values.
jenn: after merge, let's run an audit to ensure no secret creation jobs used the `@` path in prod.
ops-bot: scheduled audit job queued. ETA ~12m.
mike: merging once jenn approves. thanks all.
